name: sassymcp
description: One MCP server replacing 75+. Auto-configures Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Continue, Cline, Zed, Grok and the VS Code Copilot agent.

sassymcp.exePath.description: Override path to sassymcp.exe (default: auto-detect from PATH).

sassymcp.runInstallOnActivation.description: Run `sassymcp install` to patch every detected MCP client config when the extension activates. Set to false if you've already patched them or want to do it manually.

sassymcp.installRunOnce.description: If true, only run `sassymcp install` on the first activation per workspace. If false, run on every activation (idempotent).

sassymcp.repoPath.description: Path to the SassyMCP repo root (contains hermes_node.py and the sassymcp/ package). Used by the Sassy Brain Cockpit to read the coordination board and launch the Hermes peer. Auto-detected from the workspace if empty.

sassymcp.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter for the cockpit's coordination reads and Hermes node. Auto-detects the repo's .venv if empty, else falls back to 'python'.

sassymcp.hermesNodePath.description: Override path to hermes_node.py. Defaults to <repoPath>/hermes_node.py.

sassymcp.hermesAutorun.description: Start Hermes with HERMES_AUTORUN=1 so it auto-executes clean (non-destructive) commands. Off by default: Hermes proposes, you approve.
